const music={enabled:false,ctx:null};function playTone(freq=380,lasting=.09,type='sine',vol=.024){if(!music.enabled)return;try{music.ctx ||=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();const a=music.ctx,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,a.currentTime);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,a.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,a.currentTime+lasting);o.connect(g).connect(a.destination);o.start();o.stop(a.currentTime+lasting)}catch(e){}}
function sound(type){if(type==='money'){playTone(580,.07);setTimeout(()=>playTone(850,.13),90)}else if(type==='wrong')playTone(145,.19,'sawtooth',.014);else if(type==='door')playTone(220,.16,'triangle',.015);else if(type==='done'){playTone(470,.07);setTimeout(()=>playTone(690,.12),110)}else playTone(340,.07)}

const fresh=()=>({scene:'reception',x:610,y:621,cash:3,heat:0,stress:15,bag:false,inv:[],flags:{},journal:['Je hebt €3 en moet €850 bij elkaar krijgen.'],visited:['reception'],minute:0,ending:null,selected:null,achievements:[],thefts:0,drinks:0});
let s=fresh(),started=false,last=performance.now(),hover=null,pending=null,path=[],walkTimer=0,tab='tasks',dlg=null,modal=null,toaster=null,playerFlip=1;
function has(id){return s.inv.includes(id)}function flag(id){return !!s.flags[id]}function put(id){if(!has(id))s.inv.push(id);drawInventory();save()}
function remove(id){s.inv=s.inv.filter(v=>v!==id);drawInventory();save()}
function note(t){if(!s.journal.includes(t))s.journal.unshift(t);if(s.journal.length>50)s.journal.length=50;refreshSide();save()}
function achieve(t){if(!s.achievements.includes(t)){s.achievements.push(t);toast('Prestatie: '+t);sound('done')}}
function money(n){s.cash=Math.max(0,s.cash+n);sound(n>0?'money':'wrong');syncUI()}
function heat(n){s.heat=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,s.heat+n));syncUI();if(s.heat>=100){s.heat=35;const confiscated=['lens','camera','rc'].filter(has);confiscated.forEach(remove);money(-Math.min(s.cash,70));s.scene='reception';s.x=660;s.y=642;s.thefts+=0;note('Je werd betrapt. De spullen zijn terug en je bent geld kwijt.');say('Sanne','Je blijft hier even. We moeten praten over die tas.',[{t:'Ik doe vanaf nu normaal.',f:()=>{closeDialog();toast('Je kunt verder spelen, maar de spullen zijn ingenomen.')}}],'Receptie');return}}
function stress(n){s.stress=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,s.stress+n));syncUI()}
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('cantique_sem_game_v10',JSON.stringify(s))}catch(e){}}
function load(){try{const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('cantique_sem_game_v10'));if(x&&x.scene&&scenes[x.scene]){s={...fresh(),...x};s.inv=Array.isArray(s.inv)?s.inv:[];s.flags=s.flags||{};s.visited=s.visited||['reception'];s.journal=s.journal||[];return true}}catch(e){}return false}
function syncUI(){$('cash').textContent='€ '+s.cash.toLocaleString('nl-NL');$('heat').textContent=Math.round(s.heat)+'%';$('stress').textContent=Math.round(s.stress)+'%';$('sceneName').textContent=scenes[s.scene].name;$('sceneSub').textContent=scenes[s.scene].sub;drawInventory();refreshSide();save()}
function drawInventory(){const el=$('inventory');el.innerHTML='';if(!s.inv.length){el.innerHTML='<span class="invEmpty">Alleen €3. Je kunt altijd nog om hulp vragen.</span>';return}for(const id of s.inv){const m=itemMeta[id]||[id,'','Onbekend object'];const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='inv'+(s.selected===id?' active':'');const icon=m[1]?'<img src="'+imagePaths[m[1]]+'" alt="">':'<span style="font-size:24px;color:#eed59c">▣</span>';b.innerHTML=icon+'<span>'+m[0]+'</span>';b.title=m[2];b.onclick=()=>{s.selected=s.selected===id?null:id;drawInventory(); if(id==='packet')packetChoice();else toast(m[0]+' — '+m[2]);save()};el.append(b)} }
const tasks=()=>[
 ['Haal €850 bij elkaar',s.cash>=850],['Vind je zwarte laptoptas',flag('bag')],['Lever de proefdruk af (€90)',flag('proofDone')],['Help Johanneke met de productie (€75)',flag('sortDone')],['Zoek Marloes’ factuur (€60)',flag('invoiceDone')],['Breng de USB naar Marthijn (€120)',flag('usbDone')],['Help Maarten met zijn film (€100)',flag('editDone')],['Verdien statiegeld in de kantine (€5)',flag('cansDone')],['Kies: eerlijk verdienen of spullen meenemen',s.thefts>0||goodJobs()>=4],['Ga met genoeg geld naar de uitgang',!!s.ending]];
function goodJobs(){return ['proofDone','sortDone','invoiceDone','usbDone','editDone'].filter(flag).length}
function refreshSide(){const el=$('sideContent');if(tab==='tasks'){let h='<h2>Sems financiële noodtoestand</h2><strong>€ '+s.cash+' / € 850</strong><div class="goalMeter"><span style="width:'+Math.min(100,s.cash/850*100)+'%"></span></div><p>'+ (s.cash>=850?'Je hebt genoeg geld. Ga naar de uitgang buiten om het verhaal af te ronden.':'Neem klusjes aan, onderzoek ruimtes of praat met Maarten over een lening. Je keuzes hebben gevolgen.')+'</p>';for(const [a,done] of tasks())h+='<div class="task'+(done?' done':'')+'"><i>'+(done?'✓':'○')+'</i><span>'+a+'</span></div>';el.innerHTML=h;}
else if(tab==='map'){let h='<h2>Bezochte plekken</h2><p>Een plek op deze kaart is pas beschikbaar als je er zelf bent geweest. De deuren in de wereld zijn de normale route.</p>';for(let [id,c] of Object.entries(scenes)){const seen=s.visited.includes(id);h+='<button class="mapBtn '+(s.scene===id?'active':'')+'" data-scene="'+id+'" '+(seen?'':'disabled')+'>'+(seen?'':'· ') + c.name+'</button>'}el.innerHTML=h;el.querySelectorAll('[data-scene]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(!dlg&&!modal&&started)travel(b.dataset.scene)})}
else{el.innerHTML='<h2>Wat is er gebeurd?</h2>'+s.journal.slice(0,18).map(x=>'<div class="journal">'+escapeHtml(x)+'</div>').join('')+'<p>Prestaties: '+s.achievements.length+'</p>'}}
function escapeHtml(x){return String(x).replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[ch]))}
function toast(t){const e=$('toast');e.textContent=t;e.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toaster);toaster=setTimeout(()=>e.hidden=true,2800)}
function imageGet(k){return images[k]}
function drawImage(k,x,y,w,h){const i=imageGet(k);if(i?.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0)ctx.drawImage(i,x,y,w,h)}
function shadow(x,y,r){ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#0507086b';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,Math.max(3,r*.22),0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore()}
function npcVisible(n){if(n.id==='dirkjan'&&flag('dirkTask'))return true;return true}
function drawNPC(n,t){if(!npcVisible(n))return;let [x,y]=n.at;ctx.save();shadow(x,y,31*n.scale);if(n.kind==='desk'){let num=1+Math.floor(t/1250)%3;const im=imageGet(n.full+'_desk_'+num);if(im?.naturalWidth){let w=150*n.scale,h=w*(im.height/im.width);ctx.drawImage(im,x-w/2,y-h,w,h)}}else{let im=imageGet('full_'+n.full);if(im?.naturalWidth){let h=(225*(.60+y/950))*n.scale,w=h*(im.width/im.height);ctx.drawImage(im,x-w/2,y-h,w,h)}}ctx.restore()}
function drawPlayer(t){if(!started||s.scene==='cabinet')return;const active=path.length>0;const scale=.67+s.y/1800;const h=233*scale;const id=active? 'sem_walk_'+(1+Math.floor(walkTimer/125)%7):'sem_walk_1';let im=imageGet(id);if(!im?.naturalWidth)im=imageGet('full_sem');if(!im?.naturalWidth)return;const w=h*(im.width/im.height);shadow(s.x,s.y,w*.29);ctx.save();if(playerFlip<0){ctx.translate(s.x,s.y);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(im,-w/2,-h,w,h)}else ctx.drawImage(im,s.x-w/2,s.y-h,w,h);ctx.restore()}
function hotspotRect(h){return h.rect}
function hotspotFound(x,y){const a=scenes[s.scene].hot;for(let j=a.length-1;j>=0;j--){const h=a[j],r=h.rect;if(x>=r[0]&&y>=r[1]&&x<=r[0]+r[2]&&y<=r[1]+r[3])return h}return null}
function drawGlowing(h,t){if(!h)return;const [x,y,w,hg]=h.rect,mid=x+w/2,cy=y+hg/2;ctx.save();const p=(Math.sin(t/250)+1)/2;let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(mid,cy,0,mid,cy,Math.max(w,hg)*.64);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,233,158,'+(0.20+p*.12)+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,229,140,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-18,y-18,w+36,hg+36);ctx.restore()}
function drawWorld(t){ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const b=s.scene==='cabinet'?(flag('cabinetOpen')?'bg_cabinet_open':'bg_cabinet_closed'):'bg_'+s.scene;drawImage(b,0,0,W,H);const c=scenes[s.scene];for(let n of c.npcs||[])drawNPC(n,t);for(let item of c.extra||[]){if(item.hideFlag&&flag(item.hideFlag))continue;const [x,y,w,h]=item.rect;drawImage(item.sprite,x,y,w,h)}drawPlayer(t);if(hover||pending?.hot){drawGlowing(hover||pending.hot,t)}ctx.save();const vig=ctx.createRadialGradient(480,330,100,480,350,690);vig.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');vig.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,.19)');ctx.fillStyle=vig;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.restore();if(s.stress>78){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(101,66,36,'+((s.stress-78)/400)+')';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H)}}
function pnpoly(x,y,vs){let inside=false;for(let i=0,j=vs.length-1;i<vs.length;j=i++){const xi=vs[i][0],yi=vs[i][1],xj=vs[j][0],yj=vs[j][1];const intersect=((yi>y)!=(yj>y))&&(x<(xj-xi)*(y-yi)/(yj-yi)+xi);if(intersect)inside=!inside}return inside}
function inWalk(x,y){return pnpoly(x,y,scenes[s.scene].floor)}
function findPath(x,y){const gx=48,gy=36,sx=Math.max(0,Math.min(47,Math.floor(s.x/20))),sy=Math.max(0,Math.min(35,Math.floor(s.y/20)));let endX=Math.floor(x/20),endY=Math.floor(y/20);const valid=(px,py)=>px>=0&&py>=0&&px<gx&&py<gy&&inWalk(px*20+10,py*20+10);if(!valid(endX,endY)){let min=Infinity,best=null;for(let yy=0;yy<gy;yy++)for(let xx=0;xx<gx;xx++){if(!valid(xx,yy))continue;let d=(xx*20+10-x)**2+(yy*20+10-y)**2;if(d<min){min=d;best=[xx,yy]}}if(!best)return[];[endX,endY]=best}let start=[sx,sy];if(!valid(sx,sy)){let min=Infinity;for(let yy=0;yy<gy;yy++)for(let xx=0;xx<gx;xx++)if(valid(xx,yy)){let d=(xx
